name: done-premerge-mainsha-recheck
title: Abort DONE before persist when main advanced after the lock (pre-merge mainSha re-check)
description: Close the one residual DONE race left by the existing main-write-lock: an EXTERNAL git advance to main between the pre-check sync and the in-lock merge. After acquiring the lock and before merging, re-read main's sha; if it changed, abort BEFORE phase=DONE persists, leaving the story at TEST with a resync hint. No after-DONE auto-retry; the merge stays atomic.
